name: Terra Firma Capital Corporation
summary: Terra Firma Capital Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides real estate financings secured by investment properties and real estate developments in Canada and the United States. It arranges financing for residential and commercial development, residential buildings and mixed-use properties, and construction projects. The company provides land and lot inventory loans registered in first or second position at the earlier stages of real estate development; term mortgages for the purpose of acquiring or refinancing income-producing properties; and mezzanine or subordinated debt financing on real estate development. It serves real estate developers and owners. Terra Firma Capital Corporation was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
